name: dairy-data-tools
description: Skills for dairy nutritionists, vets and consultants working from a farm's own DairyComp and EZfeed exports: the DairyComp commands to export with, the herd and each pen and cow, pen cows joined to pen feed (intake, ECM per lb DM, cost per cwt, IOFC), a weekly or visit review, and a ration change with the season taken out. Read-only Python scripts, no network; results as cards.
